top_strength: The cleanest pricing delivery of this batch. He gave the true per-mover framing ($102/hr per mover, $204/hr for a two-mover team), then the hardest no-hidden-fees pitch on record — no travel fees, no credit card processing fees, no taxes, 'literally nothing else whatsoever' — followed by a clear clock explanation and a sense-check. He also gave genuinely useful unprompted logistics coaching on reserving the freight elevator and how the load and unload windows should line up.
coaching_note: Ethan told him about a 40-inch framed mirror and Jack never came back to it — no No Worries Damage Coverage, no special-handling plan, no time added to the estimate. When a customer volunteers a fragile item, that is the cue for the damage-coverage pitch; skipping it left the biggest trust-builder on the table on a call that ended unbooked.
phone_presence_notes: Energetic, clear, and conversationally casual ('pain in the butt', 'have a good day my friend'), and Ethan stayed engaged and asked follow-ups — held back from a 5 by never once using the customer's name.
